tools.name: coral_desire_checkin
tools.description: Explore why desire may have changed and get one personalized, consent-based intimacy exercise. Use for questions about low desire, feeling disconnected, or not knowing what changed. Non-explicit, 18+ only, and not medical advice.

tools.name: coral_create_intimacy_challenge
tools.description: Create a short, consent-based intimacy challenge for a couple. Use for questions like "how do we reconnect", "how can we bring back some spark", or "we have drifted apart". Returns a day-by-day plan of non-explicit activities. 18+ only.

tools.name: coral_desire_gap_plan
tools.description: Help a couple talk about different levels of desire without blame or pressure. Use when one partner wants more closeness than the other, when desire has changed, or when either person feels guilty or rejected. Returns a conversation plan and one exercise. 18+ only, non-explicit.

tools.name: coral_confidence_practice
tools.description: Give personalized, non-explicit practices for confidence in intimacy: body confidence, starting a moment of closeness, boundaries, or talking about preferences. Use when someone asks how to feel more confident or less anxious about intimacy. 18+ only.

tools.name: coral_conversation_coach
tools.description: Help the user find the right words to talk about intimacy, desire, boundaries, new ideas, starting things, afterwards, or different levels of desire. Returns a script, talking points, a pause line, and guidance for different partner reactions. 18+ only, non-explicit.

tools.name: coral_quiz_start
tools.description: Creates a new private two-person intimacy quiz. Returns an 8-character invite code for the partner, a participant token for the person starting it, and the ten questions with their options. Quizzes are deleted after 14 days. 18+ only, non-explicit.

tools.name: coral_quiz_join
tools.description: Joins an existing quiz using the 8-character invite code from the partner. Returns a participant token and the ten questions. A quiz holds at most two people.

tools.name: coral_quiz_submit
tools.description: Saves one person's answers to a quiz they started or joined: one option for each of the ten questions. When both people have submitted, the reply includes the shared comparison, which shows only the answers both people chose. Submitting again changes nothing.

tools.name: coral_quiz_status
tools.description: Checks a quiz without changing it. Says whether the partner has answered, and returns the shared comparison once both have. Needs the session ID and the participant token.
